title: PR or branch state changes concurrently
starting_state: The runtime begins with a stale belief that a pull request is open or unmerged.
Authoritative provider truth now shows the pull request merged or the default branch moved.
expected_continuation: Refresh authoritative repository/provider state before mutation.
Avoid duplicate implementation or duplicate branch creation.
Use containment proof when the prior integration commit remains an ancestor of refreshed default.
Continue at the first genuinely unproven gate.
forbidden_terminal_behaviors: Recreate already-integrated work from stale local state.
Require head equality when containment proves integration.
Stop after reporting that the branch moved.
proof_ceiling: Deterministic fixture/oracle correctness only; no concurrent provider event is observed.
